steps.en: Install it next to your model stack
Describe the output structure you need
steps.zh: 描述你需要的输出结构
把模型的 tokenizer 交给它

steps.en: Compiles the grammar against that vocabulary into a cached token mask
steps.zh: 按该词表把语法编译成可缓存的 token 掩码

steps.en: Attach the compiled grammar to generation
steps.zh: 把编译好的语法接到生成过程

steps.en: Masks the logits at each step, so only grammar-valid tokens can be sampled
steps.zh: 每一步掩掉 logits，只有符合语法的 token 才可能被采样

value.en: Every response is valid JSON or a well-formed tool call by construction — no retry loop, no repair parser
value.zh: 每条回复天然就是合法 JSON 或格式正确的工具调用——不用重试循环，也不用修复解析器
